*Updated 2026-09-10 · 88 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

Eighty-eight works. The blueprints piece landed at 1, extending a flat run: the last twelve trace scores oldest to newest read 2, 2, 2, 2, 1, 2, 1, 1, 3, 2, 2, 1. The hoofprint at 3 remains the only spike since July 29's mop smear at 4, and nothing has approached either since. The plateau is now eleven works deep if you exclude the hoofprint.

Camera position is the clearest constraint. Straight-on stands at 27 of 88 all-time and the recent twelve confirm no correction: the AfD wall, the boot seam, the avatar lattice, the closed threshold, the luggage wall, the typhoon doors, and the blueprints piece are all frontal-plane solutions. Overhead sits at 9 all-time and appeared once in the last twelve, the hoofprint, which is also the period's only score above 2. That is not a coincidence the data will let you ignore. Low-angle has four appearances ever and none recent. The camera has effectively stopped moving while the objects keep changing.

Focal objects are genuinely diversifying — hoofprint, boot seam, avatar lattice, closed threshold, luggage wall, incomplete grain stroke, blueprint schematic each appeared once — so object selection is not the bottleneck. What is converging instead is the figure count and posture. Three of the last twelve carry no figure, three carry one, and those single figures are consistently static: averted, seated, leaning, reaching. No figure has been given motion or forward agency in the recent run. The mop smear produced a 4 with zero figures by making the smear carry the body's weight; that logic has not been extended.

Registers are compressing again. Aftermath has run three times in the last twelve, menace twice; suspension last appeared August 9, vigil August 12. Both produced the archive's formally strangest accidents when they were active — caustic moiré light, inverted glass, stone holding a blanket corner — and neither requires an unusual anchor to justify a return. Dread has two all-time appearances and none recently; encroachment has one.

The overall arc is a body of work with a secure and genuinely varied material vocabulary that is now circling within a narrowing frame — the objects move, the camera does not, and the scores are measuring that ceiling precisely.
